article.title: CNN cleared to join CBS under Trumpian Paramount ownership
article.author: Ari Paul
article.content: Paramount’s purchase of Warner Bros. Discovery, which faced legal action and concern that Paramount boss David Ellison may be consolidating too much media power, is now going forward. The post CNN cleared to join CBS under Trumpian Paramount ownership appeared first on MR Online .
